assumptions.statement: The submitted SITE_BOUNDARY is the repository maintainer's provisional rough polygon, not an official redline or survey.
assumptions.impact: All geometry-derived areas and ratios are reproducible design-working values, not statutory quantities.
assumptions.required_data: Cleared official polygon with source, date and CRS.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Replace site and regenerate every dependent layer, figure, metric, HTML and PDF.

assumptions.statement: The three key-area polygons are provisional rough rectangles inferred from public descriptions and approximate announced areas.
assumptions.impact: Bay siting and detailed-design envelopes are conceptual, not parcel or approval boundaries.
assumptions.required_data: Official polygons for Zhongzhiyuan, Beijing AI Origin Community and Dazhongsi.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Reclip design layers and repeat spatial/professional review.

assumptions.statement: Official FAR, density, height, green ratio, setbacks and other regulatory controls are not present.
assumptions.impact: No statutory intensity or approved building scale is claimed.
assumptions.required_data: Current approved regulatory plan and associated conditions.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Rebuild intensity, massing, capacity and compliance sections.

assumptions.statement: Official road redlines, sections, traffic counts, transit entrances, rail constraints and parking data are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Roads.geojson is a conceptual slow-mobility linkage diagram only.
assumptions.required_data: Surveyed road/rail/transit and transport demand data.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Transport, emergency access, logistics, parking and accessibility study.

assumptions.statement: Parcel, tenure and public/private management boundaries are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: No land acquisition, easement or implementation responsibility is assigned.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Confirm project boundaries, delivery bodies and public access duties.

assumptions.statement: Existing building footprints, use, condition, structure, ownership and heritage value are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Buildings.geojson shows conceptual adaptive carriers and makes no retain/renovate/demolish decision.
assumptions.required_data: Measured building survey, condition, tenure, structure, fire and value assessment.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Prepare building-by-building retain/renovate/demolish schedule and capacity.

assumptions.statement: Complete heritage inventory, protection zones, archaeology and archive rights are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Heritage interventions remain non-invasive principles without exact siting.
assumptions.required_data: Authoritative inventory, protection maps, value assessment and archive rights.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Heritage impact, sightline, archaeology and interpretation plan.

assumptions.statement: Utilities, drainage, flood, soil, trees, energy, telecom, fire and emergency capacity are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Open-interface utility and blue-green proposals are conceptual and unengineered.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Engineering feasibility, resilience, fire and whole-life cost review.

assumptions.statement: Population, service demand, current public facilities, accessibility conditions and operator responsibilities are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Service locations and capacities are not commitments.
assumptions.required_data: Population/service baseline, facility inventory and accountable bodies.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Service-gap, accessibility, capacity and operating model review.
